name: Dual-System Smith Decline Bench Press
instructions: On the Dual-System Power Smith Machine, adjust the central bench into the decline angle (lowering the rear headrest down toward the base frame).
Elevate and secure your legs firmly over and under the double round padded hold-down rollers at the front.
Lie back so your head rests on the declined lower section, with your lower chest positioned directly beneath the dual press handles.
Grasp the handles firmly, rotate to release the safety catches, and start with arms extended.
Inhale and lower the handles under control until they reach the lower chest line, maintaining full control.
Exhale and press upward focusing on driving tension through the lower pectorals, then safely lock the handles back into the catches.
